name: Scryfall
tagline: Magic: The Gathering card search API with rulings, printings, and bulk data
description: Public REST API for Magic: The Gathering card data. Search cards by name or full-text query, resolve exact printings, fetch rulings, set metadata, and download bulk data dumps. No API key required; rate-limited for fair use.

auth.details: No authentication or API key required. Public endpoints; identify your app via a descriptive User-Agent header (recommended).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use within rate limits; commercial use requires prior written permission

rate_limits: About 10 requests/second; space requests ~50–100ms apart; 429 if exceeded

example.response_snippet:
{
  "object": "card",
  "id": "...",
  "name": "Lightning Bolt",
  "mana_cost": "{R}",
  "type_line": "Instant",
  "oracle_text": "Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.",
  "set": "lea",
  "rarity": "common",
  "prices": { "usd": "..." }
}

use_cases: search Magic cards by name or full-text query
fetch a card's oracle text, mana cost, and prices
list printings of a card across sets
get official rulings for a card
download bulk card data dumps for offline use
